name: Oath of the Watchers
summary: Guardians against threats from beyond the material world.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
features.short: Allies gain advantage on INT, WIS and CHA saves.
features.summary: As an action, choose up to CHA-modifier creatures within 30 ft.: for 1 minute they have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure the Extraplanar
features.short: Turn aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends.
features.summary: As an action, each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey or fiend within 30 ft. that can hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.short: You and allies within 10 ft. add PB to initiative.
features.summary: When you and creatures of your choice within 10 ft. roll initiative, you all gain a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus. The range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.short: Reaction: when an ally succeeds on a mental save, deal 2d8 + CHA force.
features.summary: When you or a creature within 30 ft. succeeds on an INT, WIS or CHA save, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 + CHA force damage to the creature that forced the save.

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.short: Truesight, advantage against extraplanar foes, banish on a hit.
features.summary: As a bonus action, for 1 minute you gain truesight 120 ft., advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and can banish such a creature you hit (CHA save). Once per long rest.
